video_title: Pablo Torre BREAKS DOWN the Clippers punishment

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Lawrence Frank taking notes on criminal conspiracy
quotes.excerpt: Lawrence Frank taking notes is one of the great subplots of this whole thing.
quotes.quote: I thought that Lawrence Frank taking notes is one of the great subplots of this whole thing. The meme made real and being noted as such in this report. I start with the basketball because I think maybe the audience will appreciate how this all maybe happened in ways that they got glimpses of that I was monitoring that now we get illumination about. Lawrence Frank ends up being someone who provides an interior view of some of the conversations between Uncle Dennis and Steve Ballmer, Team Kawhi and Team Ballmer directly. And that is some of the most illuminating evidence because it is a transcript of Steve Ballmer saying, to paraphrase here, we are working in the collective economic interest of Kawhi Leonard.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer was aware of the scheme to circumvent the salary cap
quotes.excerpt: Steve Ballmer was in fact very aware of what we'll call it what it is, a scheme to circumvent the salary cap.
quotes.quote: Steve Ballmer was in fact very aware of what we'll call it what it is, a scheme to circumvent the salary cap and funnel money using a quartet of companies to satisfy the demands of Kawhi Leonard and Dennis Robertson. So Lawrence Frank, what an astounding thing to see citations to his contemporaneous notes as the divergence in interest. Gillian Zucker had a business, got a year as well. Lawrence was cited for his cooperation as a badge of honor with notes like this, helping affirm what I have been reporting for a very long time, which is that Steve Ballmer was in fact very aware of what we'll call it what it is, a scheme to circumvent the salary cap.

quotes.quote: Steve Ballmer, through his refusal to settle with the NBA, who was given the biggest punishment anyone can recall in American sports for an owner of a team. Steve got a year, Gillian Zucker had a business, got a year as well. Lawrence was cited for his cooperation as a badge of honor.
